issues.passage: The demolition crew gave the support beam one final nudge, and the entire structure collapsed.
issues.why: A final light push on a prepared/unstable beam is natural, correct use of nudge = gently push; large consequences do not make the word wrong.

fix.correctPassage: A well-timed reminder can nudge employees to complete the survey before the deadline.
wrongPassages: Only a wrecking-ball nudge could shear the steel beam free and drop the tower into rubble.
A single nudge of the thrusters was enough to hurl the rocket beyond Earth's atmosphere.
By late afternoon the harbor looked nudge, with tourist boats filling every available slip.
